pending.summary: PZ require() returns nil unless the target Lua file ends with a top-level return of the module table; callers then crash on Module.new / Module.fn.
pending.details: In Project Zomboid B42 Kahlua, `local M = require("Path/Module")` binds whatever the chunk returns. If the file only sets a global (`Module = Module or {}`) and never executes a top-level `return Module`, require resolves to nil. Call sites then fail with `attempted index: new of non-table: null` or `attempt to call a nil value`. Early env guards such as `if isServer() then return end` are not module exports. Subdirectory modules under client/server/shared must be require()'d and must return their table. Observed 2026-09-05 on HavenFollowBuddy when HFB_ActionBroker/HFB_Runtime/etc. lacked returns.
evidence: HavenFollowBuddy.lua:2203 HFB_ActionBroker.new() → attempted index: new of non-table: null (SP boot 2026-09-05)
Brain/references/build42/lua_modding_notes.md Require Pattern — File must use return at end
